theme: A clear calendar, a full list: passports this morning, then the bookings that all key off Sept 8.
greeting: The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete and the calendar is wide open — so today's real work is on the list, not the schedule. Passports this morning, then the Croatia and Florida bookings that quietly hinge on your September 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: Conor Kehoe wants to talk next week
needsAttention.detail: In the PRI intro thread, his assistant Kate offered Wed Sept 2, Thu Sept 3, or Fri Sept 4 — all mid-to-late morning your time. It's waiting on you to pick one.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the last open piece
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando villa and rooms are set for Sept 26-27; tickets for your six are the remaining hard wall, and the ticket type may need park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Two trip nights still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel and transfer, plus the Sept 20-22 St Pete landing gap, are both overdue P1s — and charter connectivity means they must be locked before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Croatia checked bags aren't confirmed
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy ticket shows zero checked bags; confirm on Eurowings Discover's site with the record locator and buy them online before airport rates.

needsAttention.title: Refundable Tampa car as a hedge
needsAttention.detail: Book a refundable full-size SUV for Sept 20-Oct 5 at TPA unless Mike's car is confirmed heading south; the real decision point is Sept 7.

schedule.title: Passport appointments — the four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office; checks payable to U.S. Dept of State, don't sign the DS-11s until told

flagged.title: Nautilus final payment is due
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks reminder on invoice 2170 — $6,475 balance for the sailing course — plus a nudge from Amy on the final payment.

flagged.title: Sitters are applying on Care.com
flagged.detail: Several caregiver applications landed overnight against your posting — worth a skim if you're still filling it.

inbox.noise: The usual reading pile: NYT Cooking, the Midcoast Villager, a Liberty Mutual renewal notice.

resolved.title: Tokyo contacts circled back
resolved.detail: Furuta at JOMON and Isao Sakai's office both replied to your Sept 30 visit note — each will flag outside-board openings, nothing owed in return.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: Late-August tomatoes and cucumbers are at their peak, so a cool composed salad is the easiest way to let them shine.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a power strip

acts.line: The one fixed point is the 9:30 passport appointment; the packet being complete is what the morning turns on.
Open water on the calendar — the rare kind of afternoon that can swallow a backlog whole.
Home with the girls in St. Pete as the heat lets up.
